title: Mag-9

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Bell Mag-9 is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1331g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT certifications with an acoustically tuned ~98 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Versatile sena-ready open face with internal sun shield.

variants.title: Bell Mag-9 Matte Black
variants.description: The Bell Mag-9 is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in United States 🇺🇸. Built around 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. American helmet pioneer establishing safety standards since 1954.

product_details.description: Versatile sena-ready open face with internal sun shield.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Bell's Open Face lineup, the Mag-9 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
variants.story:
The Bell Mag-9 represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Mag-9 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.

variants.editorial_note: Bell Mag-9 in Bell Mag-9 Matte Black. A classic open-cranial helmet offering featherweight comfort and effortless cool for relaxed scenic rides.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Intermediate Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open face design offers maximum visibility and ventilation; suitable for warm weather riding.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Mag-9: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Bell Mag-9: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Bell Mag-9. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner engineered for open-air comfort and easy maintenance.
real_world_pros: Unrestricted 180-degree panoramic field of view for scanning traffic
Featherweight shell construction eliminates neck fatigue on casual rides
Plush, fully removable and washable moisture-wicking crown liner
real_world_cons: Open-face configuration lacks lower chin bar impact protection
Elevated cockpit wind noise at highway speeds requires earplugs
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Bell Mag-9 is a benchmark Open Face helmet, engineered to deliver verified safety and all-day acoustic comfort.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Wide-vision jet shield with opti-clear optical clarity and optional peak sun deflection.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
